alt.en: A large dark graphics card stands at the center of a gray floor. A dashed orange line carrying one packet runs from the card to a violet sphere on the left, and a dotted violet line runs down to the card from a gray satellite floating above on the right.
alt.zh: 灰色地面中央立着一张大号深色显卡。一条带数据包的橙色虚线从显卡连到左侧的紫色球体，右上方悬浮着一颗灰色卫星，一条紫色点线从卫星向下连到显卡。

caption.en: Illustration: a hidden state is read out of a running GPU while a probe watches from above, standing for the request-level analysis the paper describes. It does not depict a tested deployment, and it does not show that the method works as reported.
caption.zh: 示意图：探针从上方观察，同时从运行中的 GPU 读出一个隐藏状态，代表论文所描述的请求级分析。图中并非经过测试的实际部署，也不表明该方法如报告所述有效。
